lastCompletedLayerName: BIOS, UEFI, embedded-controller, and firmware interactions
reason: Integrated the observation-only FirmwareProfile capability into UX-ROM using the documented GetFirmwareType API, a redacted Win32_BIOS projection, a non-elevating Secure Boot status attempt, HP BIOS WMI class-metadata discovery, five-second CIM timeouts, monotonic query calibration, unique structured evidence, Layer 3 workflow routing, and the single full-diagnostics manifest. The final passive lab run identified UEFI, BIOS T76 01.24.02, SMBIOS 3.3, and 12 HP BIOS metadata classes without reading setting instances or invoking a write interface. The core observer measured 20.319 ms median and 27.465 ms p95 across three calibrated queries. Secure Boot status was unavailable without elevation and was preserved as such. No firmware, Secure Boot, BIOS setting, Windows state, or boot configuration changed, and no boot-time or performance-gain claim was made.
